text:
Sam (AcctMgr): Quick preflight for Zenith's private deployment tomorrow — networking & IAM + KMS audit are the blockers I saw in the ticket.
Leah (CS): Thanks. Are we still waiting on their VPC peering? last note said they're doing firewall changes.
Victor (NetEng): They confirmed peering established in prod-ish VPC at 10:15 UTC. I saw a failed route propagation on their side earlier.
Sam (AcctMgr): @Victor can you run a quick traceroute to the gw ip? customer gave: `34.82.11.204`
Victor (NetEng): ran it, short output:
```
traceroute to 34.82.11.204 (34.82.11.204), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.28 ms
 2  34.82.11.204  1.12 ms
```
Leah (CS): OK good. Next: IAM — they need cross-account role for the private control plane. Priya, any policy comments?
Priya (Security): We'll need an assume-role with MFA enforcement + least privilege for logging. I put a sample `trust-policy.json` in the ticket.
Leah (CS): Can you paste the minimal policy so we can share with their infra team?
Priya (Security): Sure:
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodControlPlane"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"Bool":{"aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent":"true"}}}
  ]
}
```
Sam (AcctMgr): Thanks. KMS question — customer asked about using their CMK in a different account. Is that supported for private?
Leah (CS): Yes via key grants and cross-account key usage; need export policy + audit plan. Priya, flag any compliance risk?
Priya (Security): Cross-account CMK is ok but logging backlog + key rotation window needs agreement. If they rotate without notifying us, we should have fallback keys configured. Added note to ticket.
DeployBot: checklist updated — NETWORKING:done IAM:in-progress KMS:needs-action AUDIT:in-progress
Sam (AcctMgr): Renewal risk check — usage baseline looks low for Zenith; if onboarding takes >7 days, we may need an enablement session to reduce churn.
Leah (CS): Let's schedule a 30m runbook walk-through tomorrow 11:00am PT with their infra lead. @Victor @Priya can you join?
Victor (NetEng): I can.
Priya (Security): I can too.
Sam (AcctMgr): I'll send calendar invite and include the trust-policy + traceroute log. Also capturing feedback: they asked for clearer guidance on private logging retention options.
Leah (CS): Action items: 1) Leah – send invite & collate docs; 2) Victor – confirm peering + route table by 10:00am PT; 3) Priya – finalize trust policy + KMS fallback notes; 4) Sam – monitor renewal flag and prep enablement slide.
Sam (AcctMgr): :thumbsup: I'll update the ticket and ping if anything slips.
